<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

The Awtsmoos reveals that speed, glass, and control are not ornaments but vessels: each reflection must cost little, each motion must teach direction, and each API boundary must remain measurable in Awtsmoos.com.
-->
# Phase One — Broad Possibility Map

## UX possibilities
- Sharper rectangular glass panels with clipped or small-radius corners rather than pill-heavy cards.
- A HUD-like reference workspace: compact rows, status rails, and media slots instead of giant explanation cards.
- Layered glass using one compositor-friendly blur layer rather than many nested backdrop filters.
- Subtle scan-line, border-trace, parallax-light, and hover/focus animations with reduced-motion fallbacks.
- Stronger contrast hierarchy: black glass, graphite rails, lime data accents, violet/cyan refractions.
- Compact rectangular menus with clear selected state and faster thumb scanning.
- Reference guidance that collapses into concise inline rules instead of occupying large permanent height.
- Better asset thumbnails and visible per-reference role/state.
- Image replacement/update action that visibly confirms the new media and persists immediately.

## Performance possibilities
- Reduce nested backdrop-filter count.
- Restrict animated properties to transform, opacity, filter only where necessary.
- Add `contain` / `content-visibility` selectively to long off-screen sections.
- Lazy-render heavy media previews and defer video metadata work.
- Avoid whole-view rerenders for prompt/reference micro-updates.
- Debounce only expensive persistence, never visible feedback.
- Reuse object URLs and revoke stale ones deterministically.
- Avoid repeated fetches of provider status where cached state is sufficient.

## API verification possibilities
- Inventory every browser -> Awtsmoos proxy call.
- Inventory every Awtsmoos proxy -> MiniMax call.
- Validate HTTP methods, paths, headers, JSON shapes, error forwarding, timeouts, status mapping, and result extraction.
- Validate every H3 mode against official V2 rules.
- Validate image MIME, size, dimensions, ratio, role, count, and data/public-URL handling.
- Verify first/last-frame roles never mix with reference roles.
- Verify reference audio cannot be the only reference media.
- Verify text mode never emits `adaptive` ratio because official H3 requires a concrete ratio for text-only generation.
- Verify task polling uses `/v2/query/video_generation/{task_id}` and reads `task.content.url`.
- Verify provider errors 400/401/402/422/429/500 remain understandable to the UI.
